verdict.rationale: Conductor offers cloud workspaces and sandboxes that spin up in seconds. Its docs say the cloud computer has install and setup scripts, which an agent can edit, test, and use to run builds, so per-repo setup steps are configurable. The evidence is thin, though: it never documents how you define the environment yourself, never describes the configuration format, and never shows that environments rebuild identically each time. Missing for 10: first-party docs on defining setup/install scripts and dependencies, a guarantee of reproducible or snapshotted environments, dependency caching or image details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
